task.goal:
Add the following expenses into the pro expense:
Expense: Night Out
 amount_dollars: $263.95
 category_name: Social
 note: A need

Expense: Rent Payment
 amount_dollars: $231.73
 category_name: Housing
 note: Want to have

Expense: Taxi Fare
 amount_dollars: $494.58
 category_name: Transportation
 note: Monthly recurring
task.final_summary: I added all three expenses to Pro Expense. Night Out ($263.95, Social, note "A need"), Rent Payment ($231.73, Housing, note "Want to have") and Taxi Fare ($494.58, Transportation, note "Monthly recurring") are each saved with today's date, and the home screen's weekly outcome total now reads 990.26 USD, which matches the three amounts added together.

steps.note: Observe current screen and check for a matching skill
Launch com.arduia.expense and observe home screen
Read Pro Expense home screen to find add button
Tap add button and read the new expense form
Type amount 263.95 into amount field
Select Social category and type note 'A need'
Verify Social chip checked, then type note 'A need'
Read back all fields then tap SAVE for Night Out
Confirm saved and Night Out appears in recent list
Fill Rent Payment form: name, 231.73, Housing, note
Tap add button to open entry form for Rent Payment
Type 231.73 in amount, select Housing, type note
Select Housing chip, then type note 'Want to have'
Verify Housing checked, type note 'Want to have', save
Read back Rent Payment fields and tap SAVE
Confirm Rent Payment saved; then open add form for Taxi Fare
Open expense form for Taxi Fare and fill name/amount
Type 494.58 amount, scroll category row to Transportation, select it, type note
Scroll the category row left to reveal Transportation chip
Look for Transportation chip in the category row after horizontal scroll
Verify Transportation checked, type note 'Monthly recurring', save
Read back Taxi Fare fields and tap SAVE
Confirm Taxi Fare saved and totals show 990.26
Open Taxi Fare detail to verify category and note, then back
Close detail sheet and read final home screen for confirmation
Task complete; all three expenses saved and verified
